scope: Pure separate preservation-reference and idle-probe recipe inputs; no runtime admission or TCP measurement

review.kind: Release-engineering preparation and primary source review

limitations: Pure byte inputs only: no filesystem materialization, resource creation/start/adoption, seed installation, Compose resolution or image execution.
Reference must remain created and never started; any execution violates its invariant even if the refusal stub exits78.
Synthetic image/data reference is not an initialized working-data snapshot or original runtime/configuration replica.
Declared recipe settings do not inspect inherited image VOLUME/ENV metadata or establish absence of anonymous image volumes, pinned-image Python compatibility or resource capacity.
Probe external network declaration names the planned default network but does not prove its identity or authorize adoption.
TCP measurements require fresh candidate ID/network/literal IP/ports and same-probe plus authorized-side positive controls; DNS failure is not TCP-denial evidence.
Ownership ledger, retained-resource admission, context-aware lifecycle operations and full harness remain unfinished.
